title: add slugify to textutil
prompt: Add a function slugify(text, max_length=None) to textutil.py (it already has two unrelated helpers; do not change them). Spec: NFKD-normalise the text and drop everything that is not ASCII afterwards; lowercase; every run of characters outside [a-z0-9] becomes a single '-'; strip leading and trailing '-'. If max_length is given and the slug is longer, truncate to at most max_length characters: when the cut falls inside a word, cut back to the previous '-' boundary (if the first word alone is longer than max_length, hard-cut it); the result never ends with '-'. An empty result becomes 'n-a'. max_length < 1 raises ValueError; a non-str text raises TypeError. Visible tests: run `python3 -m unittest -q` in the repository root.
